name: MA Research Project Part - II
description: This part of the research project and dissertation writing will involve developing a research idea; doing a feasibility mapping of the research idea; identifying texts, archives, sources and fields; thinking about questions of methodology; articulating possible methodological and analytical routes for the research study; doing a complete literature review; reviewing a text; identifying possible gaps in the literature; possible analysis of the literature.
